hpe_paint_document.brief: 绘制整个文档 / Paint the whole document

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.root: in:盒子树根，可为 `NULL` / Box tree root, may be `NULL`
params.scroll_y: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset
params.page_background: in:页面背景色 / Page background colour
params.origin_y: in:页面视口顶边的设备 y / Device y of the page viewport's top edge

hpe_paint_document.note: 内容被裁剪在 [origin_y, 像素缓冲高) 之内，避免画到浏览器外框上 / Content is clipped to `[origin_y, pixmap height)` so it never paints over browser chrome

hpe_paint_region.brief: 只重绘裁剪区域内的文档 / Repaint only the document inside a clip region

params.pm: inout:目标像素缓冲 / Target pixel buffer
params.root: in:盒子树根，可为 `NULL` / Box tree root, may be `NULL`
params.scroll_y: in:纵向滚动偏移 / Vertical scroll offset
params.page_background: in:页面背景色 / Page background colour
params.clip: in:设备坐标下的裁剪矩形 / Clip rect in device coordinates
params.origin_y: in:页面视口顶边的设备 y / Device y of the page viewport's top edge

hpe_paint_region.note: 供滚动损伤跟踪使用，clip 与页面视口求交 / Used by scroll damage tracking; the clip is intersected with the page viewport
